1) CHAT COM OS AGENTES (feature nova, o dono pediu):
- Agora clicar/tocar num agente abre um modal de conversa bonito e funcional.
- Modal: cabeçalho com avatar do agente, nome, cargo e botão X para fechar (ESC e clique fora também fecham). Área de mensagens com bolhas (remetente agente à esquerda, mine à direita). Campo de texto com placeholder "Fale com Nome..." e botão enviar; ENTER envia.

- Ao receber a mensagem da pessoa, mostrar bolha "digitando..." com três pontinhos animados por 800 a 1500ms, depois a resposta.
- RESPOSTAS: motor local, no próprio arquivo, função que gera a resposta considerando (a) o papel do agente, (b) o texto da pessoa, (c) o estado atual do agente. Regras simples mas com resultado vivo: saudação, pergunta "o que você faz", pergunta "o que está fazendo / como está o trabalho", agradecimento, despedida, pergunta sobre o cuidar.vc, e generica. Cada agente precisa de um repertório próprio de 4 a 6 falas por categoria, com o sotaque do papel: Dev fala de código, QA de testes, CTO de decisões técnicas, Artes de peças visuais, Copy de textos, Métricas de números, CMO de alcance e rob nomeia as agencias, PAUTA etc. Se o texto não casa com nenhuma regra, responda algo coerente com o papel combinando duas pecas do repertorio. Nada metal: nunca repetir a mesma frase duas vezes seguidas na mesma sessão.
- Guardar o historico das ultimas 6 mensagens por agente em memoria (objeto JS). Scroll da conversa acompanha a ultima bolha. Mobile: modal ocupa ate 92% da altura, bordas arredondadas, teclado ok (campo no fim).
- Todo texto em PT-BR, tom acolhedor, NENHUM travessao (nem em em dash nem hyphen longo) separando frases.

- Subir o nivel dos bonecos: cabeca com pele e cabelo (cores variadas), rosto simples com olhos, corpo com blusa colorida por agente (mesa/skin distintos por cargo), bracos e pernas. Enquanto ANDA, pernas e bracos alternam (CSS keyframes de caminhada, tipo passo esquerdo/direito). Enquanto TRABALHA, sentado na cadeira com bracos levemente inclinados ao teclado e leve balanco de digitacao. Sombra elipse no chao acompanhando o boneco.
- Proporcao tipo personagem de jogo (cabeca maior, corpo compacto). Continuar billboard de frente (locais absolutos atuais, so trocar a pele do boneco, manter a logica de posicionamento e a exclusao mutua com placas).

Zero dependencia externa.
- Organizar a pagina em blocos com respiro: header do site mais limpo (logo, badge agentes ativos, relogio), cena com sombra e margem, legenda da cena embaixo, depois o card do CMO, footer discreto. Tipografia consistente, espacamentos regulares, mobile first.

4) MELHORIAS RAPIDAS:
- Ao abrir o chat, destacar o agente escolhido (anel brilhante) e pausar seu movimento enquanto o chat esta aberto; ao fechar, retomar.
- Balao de fala ocasional continua, mas com menos frequencia quando um chat esta aberto.

REGRAS GERAIS: arquivo unico HTML, zero dependencias externas, zero erro de JavaScript, PT-BR, NENHUM travessao em qualquer texto visivel, manter o motor de movimento, rotas por corredores e desvio de placas/baloes que ja funcionam no v4.

No final, resuma o que mudou em 8 linhas no maximo.

.world{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1200px;height:900px;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:translateY(262px) translateZ(-900px) rotateX(var(--tilt))}
.world div,.world i{position:absolute}
.b,.v{transform-style:preserve-3d}
.f{backface-visibility:hidden}
.f.t{left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;transform:translateZ(var(--h));transform-style:preserve-3d}
.f.s{left:0;top:calc(100% - var(--h));width:100%;height:var(--h);transform-origin:50% 100%;transform:rotateX(-90deg)}
.f.w{left:0;top:0;width:var(--h);height:100%;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:rotateY(-90deg)}
.f.e{left:calc(100% - var(--h));top:0;width:var(--h);height:100%;transform-origin:100% 50%;transform:rotateY(90deg)}
.v{pointer-events:none}

/* floor: light oak planks running toward the viewer */
.floor{background-color:#d5a974;background-image:
 linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(60,30,10,.34),rgba(60,30,10,0) 30%,rgba(255,220,170,.10) 62%,rgba(60,30,10,.22)),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 2px,#0000 75%,rgba(90,52,22,.55) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 2px,#0000 75%,rgba(90,52,22,.55) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 2px,#0000 75%,rgba(90,52,22,.55) 0),
 linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(85,50,20,.6) 0 2px,rgba(255,236,200,.18) 2px 3px,#0000 3px),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 100%,#0000 75%,rgba(120,70,30,.13) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 100%,#0000 75%,rgba(255,230,190,.10) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 100%,#0000 75%,rgba(100,55,20,.09) 0),
 repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 5px,rgba(120,75,35,.13) 5px 6px,#0000 6px 13px,rgba(255,235,205,.10) 13px 14px,#0000 14px 23px,rgba(110,65,30,.10) 23px 24px,#0000 24px 31px),
 repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 2px,rgba(90,55,25,.07) 2px 3px,#0000 3px 9px);
 background-size:100% 100%,96px 250px,144px 310px,240px 190px,48px 100%,144px 100%,240px 100%,336px 100%,48px 100%,17px 100%;
 background-position:0 0,0 0,48px 120px,96px 60px,0 0,0 0,96px 0,192px 0,0 0,0 0}
.floor i{pointer-events:none}
.sun{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,238,190,.34),rgba(255,230,170,0));filter:blur(6px)}
.pool{border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,196,110,.30),rgba(255,180,90,0))}
.fs{border-radius:14px;background:rgba(40,20,6,.32);filter:blur(7px)}

/* bricks */
.wall{--m:#4d2a1b;background-color:#8f4b2f;background-image:
 linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,6,2,.62),rgba(15,6,2,.1) 26%,rgba(255,190,120,.05) 55%,rgba(15,6,2,.38)),
 conic-gradient(at 3px 21px,#0000 75%,var(--m) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 3px 21px,#0000 75%,var(--m) 0),
 linear-gradient(#0000 18px,var(--m) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(0,0,0,.16) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(255,170,110,.10) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(40,10,0,.18) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(190,110,60,.16) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(0,0,0,.10) 0);
 background-size:100% 100%,66px 42px,66px 42px,66px 21px,198px 63px,264px 84px,330px 105px,462px 126px,396px 147px;
 background-position:0 0,0 0,33px 21px,0 0,0 0,33px 21px,132px 42px,99px 63px,264px 0}
.wall::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:14px;background:linear-gradient(#3a2415,#23150c)}
.wall.side{filter:brightness(.82)}
.beam{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1f130b,#4a3020 25%,#3d2718 60%,#1c110a);box-shadow:5px 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5),-3px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.beam.h{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4b3120,#2d1c11 70%,#1c110a);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.brace{height:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4b3120,#2a190f);box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transform-origin:0 50%}

/* windows */
.win{border:9px solid #2c1c12;border-radius:3px;background:#2c1c12;display:grid;gap:6px;box-shadow:0 0 50px 12px rgba(255,226,160,.30),inset 0 0 0 2px #1a0f08;overflow:hidden}
.win span{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#bfe6ff 0%,#eaf8ff 55%,#fff6d6 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.win span::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 12%,#0000 12% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 30% 36%,#0000 36%)}
.win .sky{position:absolute;inset:9px;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(60px 40px at 78% 22%,rgba(255,250,215,.95),rgba(255,240,180,0))}
.win::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-12px;right:-12px;bottom:-12px;height:12px;background:#3a2517}
.sill{height:12px;background:linear-gradient(#5a3a24,#2d1c11);box-shadow:0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}

/* neon */
.neon{text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
.world .neon div,.world .frame div{position:relative}
.neon .n1{font:800 64px/1"Trebuchet MS","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:6px;color:#fff6d8;text-shadow:0 0 2px #fff,0 0 7px #ffe08a,0 0 16px #ffc13b,0 0 32px #ff9f1a,0 0 60px #ff8a00,0 0 90px rgba(255,138,0,.6);animation:flick 7s infinite}
.neon .n2{font:600 26px/1.2 "Trebuchet MS","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:8px;color:#effeff;text-shadow:0 0 2px #fff,0 0 6px #8ff7ff,0 0 14px #2de2f5,0 0 28px #00c8e8,0 0 52px #00a5d8}
.neon::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-60px;right:-60px;top:-40px;bottom:-40px;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,170,60,.22),rgba(255,170,60,0));z-index:-1}
@keyframes flick{0%,40%,44%,100%{opacity:1}42%{opacity:.72}43%{opacity:.95}}

/* pendant lamps */
.lamp .wire{left:59px;top:0;width:2px;height:calc(100% - 78px);background:#15100c}
.lamp .cap{left:52px;bottom:70px;width:16px;height:12px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3a2c20,#8a6a45 45%,#2b2017);border-radius:3px 3px 1px 1px}
.lamp .bulb{left:48px;bottom:44px;width:24px;height:28px;border-radius:50% 50% 48% 48%/58% 58% 42% 42%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 45% 42%,#fffbe8 0 18%,#ffe39a 38%,#ffb54a 80%);box-shadow:0 0 18px 6px rgba(255,196,90,.75),0 0 44px 16px rgba(255,170,60,.35)}
.lamp .halo{left:-30px;bottom:-22px;width:180px;height:160px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,200,110,.30),rgba(255,180,80,0))}

/* furniture */
.desk>.f.t{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,240,215,.20),rgba(0,0,0,0) 45%,rgba(60,30,10,.18)),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 9px,rgba(120,70,30,.10) 9px 10px,#0000 10px 23px),#c89462;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #a97443,inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255,235,200,.35)}
.desk>.f.s{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b37d4c 0 7px,#7e5330 7px 9px,#946238 9px),#8e5d35;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.desk>.f.s::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:14px;width:58px;bottom:6px;border-radius:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,#a06b40 0 calc(33.3% - 2px),#5c3a20 calc(33.3% - 2px) 33.3%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #5c3a20}
.desk>.f.s::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:8px;top:14px;width:58px;bottom:6px;border-radius:2px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#e9c68b 0 2px,#0000 2.5px),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 70%,#e9c68b 0 2px,#0000 2.5px),#a06b40;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #5c3a20}
.desk>.f.w,.desk>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6e4626,#835530)}
.desk.walnut>.f.t{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,230,200,.18),rgba(0,0,0,0) 45%,rgba(0,0,0,.25)),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 11px,rgba(20,8,0,.14) 11px 12px,#0000 12px 27px),#6a3f22;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #4a2a15,inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255,220,180,.2)}
.desk.walnut>.f.s{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#6d4225 0 7px,#3a2213 7px 9px,#553219 9px)}

.desk.walnut>.f.w,.desk.walnut>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3a2213,#4d2e18)}
.counter>.f.t{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e7e1d6,#b9b1a4);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #948b7e}
.counter>.f.s,.counter>.f.e,.counter>.f.w{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#6b4a2e 0 48px,#3e2a19 48px 50px)}
.chair-seat>.f.t{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#3d3f47,#1f2026);border-radius:8px}
.chair-seat>.f.s,.chair-seat>.f.w,.chair-seat>.f.e{background:#16171b}
.chair-back{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1c1d22,#3a3c45 45%,#1c1d22);border-radius:12px 12px 6px 6px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #121317}
.chair-back::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:44%;width:12%;top:100%;height:12px;background:#16171b}
.chair-back.exec{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3b1d12,#7a3d22 45%,#3b1d12);border-radius:16px 16px 8px 8px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #2a130a,inset 0 18px 0 -12px rgba(255,200,160,.18)}
.chair-pole{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#222,#666,#222)}
.chair-base{width:40px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,#1b1b1f 0 30%,rgba(20,20,24,.0) 32%),conic-gradient(#222 0 8%,#0000 8% 20%,#222 20% 28%,#0000 28% 40%,#222 40% 48%,#0000 48% 60%,#222 60% 68%,#0000 68% 80%,#222 80% 88%,#0000 88%);opacity:.85}
.pot>.f.t{background:radial-gradient(circle,#3b2a1c 0 55%,#d9d4cb 58%);border-radius:4px}
.pot>.f.s,.pot>.f.w,.pot>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#cfc8bc,#f0ebe3 40%,#b7afa3)}
.pot.terra>.f.s,.pot.terra>.f.w,.pot.terra>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9a4f2c,#c8714a 40%,#8a4426)}
.pot.terra>.f.t{background:radial-gradient(circle,#3b2a1c 0 55%,#b8633c 58%)}
.leaf{bottom:0;transform-origin:50% 100%;border-radius:50% 50% 45% 45%/70% 70% 30% 30%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1f5a2a 0 46%,#7dc57a 46% 52%,#2f7a37 52%);box-shadow:inset 0 -6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.leaf.l2{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2d6e30 0 47%,#9bd88f 47% 51%,#3f8e3f 51%)}
.leaf.snake{border-radius:50% 50% 10% 10%/90% 90% 10% 10%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,#2e6b35 0 6px,#5a9a4e 6px 9px),#2e6b35;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #c9c56b,inset -3px 0 0 #c9c56b}

/* monitors */

.mon .scr{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;background:#0d1117}
.mon .neck{left:calc(50% - 3px);bottom:3px;width:6px;height:11px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1c1d21,#4a4b52,#1c1d21)}
.mon .foot{left:calc(50% - 15px);bottom:0;width:30px;height:4px;background:#24252a;border-radius:3px}
.mon.lap .bez{height:calc(100% - 5px);border-radius:3px 3px 0 0}
.mon.lap .neck{display:none}
.mon.lap .foot{left:-4px;width:calc(100% + 8px);height:5px;background:linear-gradient(#c7cbd2,#8a8f98);border-radius:0 0 3px 3px}

.scr.term .ln{background:

 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#facc15 10% 65%,#0000 65%) 84% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,#0f172a}
.scr.dash .ln{height:30%;top:4px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 50%,#4ade80 0 2px,#0000 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#facc15 0 2px,#0000 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 82% 50%,#f472b6 0 2px,#0000 3px);animation:pulse 2.4s infinite}

.scr.chart .ln{height:100%;background:

.scr.check{background:#f8fafc}
.scr.check .ln{background:

 conic-gradient(at 62% 2px,#0000 75%,#94a3b8 0) 14px 6px/100% 8px repeat-y;animation:scroll 14s linear infinite}

 linear-gradient(90deg,#e2e8f0 1px,#0000 1px) 0 0/14.28% 100%,
 linear-gradient(#e2e8f0 1px,#0000 1px) 0 0/100% 25%,
 linear-gradient(#0f766e 0 18%,#fff 18%)}
.scr.design{background:
 linear-gradient(#f472b6,#f472b6) 12% 22%/34% 40% no-repeat,
 radial-gradient(circle,#facc15 0 30%,#0000 32%) 70% 26%/40% 60% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(#38bdf8,#38bdf8) 60% 82%/58% 16% no-repeat,

.scr.mail .ln{background:

@keyframes grow{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.8)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}

/* desk clutter */
.kb{height:13px;border-radius:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#3b3d44 0 3px,#23242a 3px 4px),#2a2b31;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #111;transform:translateZ(.6px)}
.mouse{width:7px;height:10px;border-radius:4px;background:#2a2b31;transform:translateZ(.6px)}
.paper{background:linear-gradient(#0000 0 4px,#b9b2a4 4px 5px,#0000 5px 8px,#b9b2a4 8px 9px,#0000 9px 12px,#b9b2a4 12px 13px,#0000 13px) 3px 3px/70% 100% no-repeat,#fbf8f1;box-shadow:1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25);transform:translateZ(.8px)}
.mug{border-radius:2px 2px 5px 5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c9c2b6,#fffdf8 40%,#bdb5a8)}
.mug::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-5px;top:3px;width:5px;height:6px;border:2px solid #d8d1c5;border-left:0;border-radius:0 5px 5px 0}
.mug.red{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8f1f1f,#e04a3a 40%,#7d1a1a)}
.mug.teal{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0f5e57,#1fb3a3 40%,#0b4a44)}
.steam{left:2px;top:-18px;width:10px;height:18px}
.steam i{bottom:0;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);filter:blur(1.5px);animation:rise 2.6s ease-out infinite}
.steam i:nth-child(2){left:4px;animation-delay:.9s}
.steam i:nth-child(3){left:1px;animation-delay:1.7s}
@keyframes rise{0%{transform:translateY(4px) scale(.5);opacity:0}30%{opacity:.8}100%{transform:translateY(-16px) scale(1.4);opacity:0}}
.book>.f.t{background:#f3ead6}
.book>.f.s,.book>.f.e,.book>.f.w{background:var(--bc)}
.dlamp{width:30px}
.dlamp::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:13px;bottom:0;width:4px;height:34px;background:#222;transform:rotate(-12deg);transform-origin:50% 100%}
.dlamp::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:4px;top:0;width:24px;height:12px;border-radius:12px 12px 2px 2px;background:linear-gradient(#1f4d3c,#12302a);box-shadow:0 8px 14px rgba(255,210,120,.6)}

/* rack */
.rack>.f.t{background:#141517}
.rack>.f.w,.rack>.f.e{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#101113 0 6px,#1b1c20 6px 8px)}
.rack>.f.s{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b0c0e,#1b1d21 50%,#0b0c0e);padding:10px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}

## claude.ai Lovable
Lovable is an AI-powered full-stack app builder. The AI agent edits TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui code in a cloud sandbox with a live preview.

New projects use Lovable's backend default stack. There is no tech stack selector in `create_project`; include framework or rendering preferences in the initial message.

What Lovable can build:
- Landing pages, dashboards, SaaS apps, internal tools, marketplaces, and more
- Full-stack apps with authentication (Supabase Auth), databases (PostgreSQL), file storage, and edge functions
- Apps with payments (Stripe), email (Resend), AI features, and 20+ integrations
- See https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/introduction for the full integration catalog

How to interact:
- Use create_project with initial_message and workspace_id. If multiple workspaces are possible, create_project returns available_workspaces; choose one or ask the user, then call create_project again with workspace_id. - Send natural-language messages via send_message — describe what you want built or changed
- send_message and create_project initial messages send work from the MCP client's AI agent to Lovable's AI agent on the user's behalf and consume the user's workspace credits.

- Attach images (designs, screenshots, wireframes) via file uploads to guide visual implementation
- Use plan_mode=true on send_message to discuss approach before the agent writes code
- Iterate: review changes with get_diff, then send follow-up messages to refine
